title: 1.1 "Site of the Day" hero  Best for: SaaS, app, tool.
prompt: Create a cinematic dark-mode SaaS hero, full viewport. Near-black background (#0a0a0b) with a slow-drifting gradient mesh (amber→magenta) behind everything. Oversized serif display headline (clamp 56–120px, tight leading) on the left, thin sans subheadline below, and a single glowing CTA. On the right, a glassmorphic floating product card with soft inner glow and subtle scroll parallax. Add fine film grain, edge vignette, and a slow staggered fade-in on load. Fonts: Inter + Instrument Serif. Framer Motion for entrance + parallax. Make it feel like an Awwwards Site of the Day.

title: 1.2 Scroll-driven SaaS landing (full)  Best for: an entire SaaS page.
prompt: Build a full cinematic SaaS landing in Next.js + Tailwind + Framer Motion + Lenis smooth scroll. Dark, dramatic, Apple × Awwwards. Sections: (1) hero with looping muted background video + gradient scrim + staggered word-reveal headline; (2) scroll-pinned feature showcase with horizontal parallax cards; (3) bento grid of product shots with hover glow; (4) glassmorphic pricing; (5) cinematic footer with giant CTA + film grain. Reduced-motion fallback, fully responsive, semantic HTML, swappable placeholder assets.

title: 1.3 SaaS with a 3D product  Best for: hardware, gadget, an app with an "object".
prompt: Cinematic SaaS hero with an interactive 3D product centerpiece (Spline or React-Three-Fiber). Black stage, single dramatic key light on the object, soft floor reflection. Thin uppercase headline with wide tracking orbiting the object. Cursor-reactive parallax on the 3D model, drifting particle dust, floating glass nav on top. Weightless, premium, cinematic.

title: 1.4 Dashboard reveal (bento + motion)  Best for: data-driven SaaS, analytics, fintech.
prompt: Design a cinematic "dashboard reveal" section. The dashboard UI starts blurred and tilted in 3D perspective, then snaps sharp and upright on scroll-into-view. Surround it with floating bento cards (metrics, charts, avatars) animating in with staggered springs. Dark theme, neon data accents, glass surfaces, ambient glow under the dashboard. Framer Motion scroll-linked animation.

title: 1.5 Cinematic pricing + CTA  Best for: closing the SaaS page.
prompt: Create a cinematic pricing + final CTA section on near-black. Three glassmorphic plan cards, the middle one elevated with an amber glow halo and a "Most popular" ribbon; on hover it lifts with soft shadow and intensified glow. Below, a full-width cinematic CTA band with oversized serif "Start building", animated gradient underline, film grain, and a magnetic button. Framer Motion micro-interactions.

title: 2.1 Editorial portfolio hero  Best for: designer, photographer, creative.
prompt: Create a cinematic editorial portfolio hero, full viewport, dark. A single large duotone hero image (or muted portrait) bleeding to the edges, with an oversized serif name headline overlapping it and thin uppercase role/tagline. Fine grain, slow ken-burns zoom on the image, cursor-follow spotlight. Minimal glass nav. Fonts: a strong serif + mono accents. Framer Motion entrance. Awwwards editorial energy.

title: 2.2 Scroll portfolio with projects  Best for: showing work/cases.
prompt: Build a cinematic portfolio in Next.js + Tailwind + Framer Motion + Lenis. Dark, editorial. Sections: (1) name hero with kinetic type; (2) horizontal-scroll project gallery, each project a full-bleed image that scales on hover with a thin serif title reveal; (3) a "selected work" list with row hover that previews the project image following the cursor; (4) footer with big email CTA + grain. Smooth scroll, reduced-motion fallback, responsive.

title: 2.3 Personal brand / creator (kinetic)  Best for: creator, consultant, personal brand.
prompt: Cinematic personal-brand hero, near-black, minimal. Giant kinetic serif name that subtly reacts to mouse movement (letters shift/skew), a one-line manifesto below in thin sans, and a single glowing CTA. Grain overlay, soft moving vignette, one small looping video thumbnail floating with parallax. Bold, confident, gallery-like.

title: 2.4 Case study / storytelling  Best for: a single project/case page.
prompt: Design a cinematic case-study page, dark editorial. Sticky large project title on the left while imagery scrolls on the right (sticky-scroll layout). Big pull-quotes in serif between image blocks, subtle parallax on each image, a results section with animated number counters, and a "next project" full-bleed CTA at the end. Film grain, generous whitespace, Framer Motion scroll animations.

title: 2.5 Cinematic about / contact  Best for: closing the portfolio.
prompt: Create a cinematic about + contact section, near-black. Left: a duotone portrait with grain and a slow zoom. Right: a short serif bio and an oversized "Let's work together" headline that becomes a magnetic email button. Floating social links with hover glow, subtle particle background. Elegant, personal, premium.

title: 3.1 Launch hero with countdown  Best for: drop, launch, dated event.
prompt: Create a cinematic product-launch hero, near-black, high tension. Oversized serif headline "The wait is over" with a glowing animated countdown timer (days/hours/min/sec) below. A single hero product shot floating center with a rim light and slow rotation. Radial spotlight, heavy film grain, pulsing CTA "Get notified". Fonts: bold sans + serif accent. Framer Motion for the timer and entrance. Hype, premium, Awwwards.

title: 3.2 Drop page (hype/streetwear)  Best for: streetwear, sneaker, limited edition.
prompt: Build a full cinematic "drop" landing (Next + Tailwind + Framer + Lenis), dark and bold. Sections: (1) full-bleed hero with the product on a dramatic set, giant kinetic headline, "Limited drop" badge; (2) horizontal marquee of product angles; (3) sticky product showcase with scroll-zoom; (4) "sold out risk" scarcity band with counter; (5) email-capture footer with grain. Aggressive, streetwear energy, responsive.

title: 3.3 Waitlist / coming soon  Best for: pre-launch, list capture.
prompt: Design a cinematic "coming soon" / waitlist page, near-black minimal. Center: a giant serif brand name with a slow-shimmer gradient, a one-line teaser, and a sleek email input with a glowing "Join the waitlist" button. Ambient particle field drifting, subtle moving gradient background, film grain. Success state animates the button into a checkmark. Elegant, mysterious.

title: 3.4 New version/feature reveal  Best for: v2, new feature, update.
prompt: Create a cinematic "new version reveal" hero. Dark stage, a "v2.0" tag glowing, oversized headline, and the product UI emerging from darkness with a light sweep as it appears. Below, 3 glass feature cards animating in with staggered springs. Neon accent, film grain, scroll-triggered light sweep. Framer Motion. Feels like a keynote reveal.

title: 3.5 Pre-sale / early access  Best for: pre-sale with an offer.
prompt: Design a cinematic pre-order / early-access section, near-black. Left: product hero with dramatic lighting and reflection. Right: an offer card in glass with strikethrough original price, bold early-access price, a scarcity line ("first 100 only"), and a magnetic "Secure my spot" button with amber glow. Film grain, subtle confetti-free elegance. Framer Motion micro-interactions.

title: 4.1 Agency hero (statement)  Best for: agency, creative studio.
prompt: Create a cinematic agency hero, near-black, bold and confident. A giant kinetic serif statement ("We build brands that move") filling the screen, a thin one-line positioning below, and a small glowing "See our work" CTA. Background: a subtle looping abstract motion or gradient. Film grain, cursor-follow highlight on the headline. Awwwards studio energy.

title: 4.2 Full agency site  Best for: an entire agency site.
prompt: Build a full cinematic agency site (Next + Tailwind + Framer + Lenis), dark editorial. Sections: (1) statement hero with kinetic type; (2) selected work as full-bleed case tiles with hover scale + serif titles; (3) services as a scroll-pinned list that highlights row by row; (4) team/manifesto with grain; (5) big "Let's talk" CTA footer. Smooth scroll, reduced-motion fallback, responsive.

title: 4.3 Showreel hero (background video)  Best for: production house, motion, studio.
prompt: Cinematic studio showreel hero: full-viewport muted looping background video (dark, high-contrast), a heavy vignette + grain over it, oversized serif studio name centered, and a circular "Play reel" button that expands into a fullscreen video on click. Minimal glass nav. Slow, immersive, premium.

title: 4.4 Cinematic services grid  Best for: services section.
prompt: Design a cinematic services section, near-black. A bento grid of service cards in glass, each with a subtle icon, a serif title, and a one-line description; on hover the card lifts, glows, and reveals a short detail. One larger "flagship service" card spanning two columns with a moving gradient. Film grain, staggered entrance. Framer Motion.

title: 4.5 Contact / pitch CTA  Best for: closing an agency site.
prompt: Create a cinematic contact/pitch section, near-black. An oversized serif "Ready to build something unforgettable?" that becomes a magnetic email button, surrounded by floating client logos with hover glow and a subtle particle field. Grain, ambient gradient. Elegant and bold.

title: 5.1 Single-product hero (premium)  Best for: one hero product (perfume, gadget, sneaker).
prompt: Create a cinematic single-product e-commerce hero, near-black. The product floating center under a dramatic key light with soft floor reflection, oversized serif product name overlapping it, a short poetic tagline, price, and a glowing "Add to cart" button. Cursor-reactive parallax on the product, film grain, slow ambient motion. Luxury, weightless.

title: 5.2 E-commerce landing (collection)  Best for: a full store/collection.
prompt: Build a full cinematic e-commerce landing (Next + Tailwind + Framer + Lenis), dark premium. Sections: (1) collection hero with looping video + serif headline; (2) product grid with hover that lifts the card and swaps to a second image; (3) "shop the look" editorial block; (4) social proof marquee; (5) footer with newsletter + grain. Fast, responsive, swappable product data.

title: 5.3 Cinematic product page (PDP)  Best for: the product detail page.
prompt: Design a cinematic product detail page, dark editorial. Left: sticky product gallery with zoom-on-hover and thumbnail switcher; right: serif product name, price, variant selector, and a magnetic "Add to cart". Below: a full-bleed lifestyle image, specs in glass cards, and a "you may also like" carousel. Film grain, smooth transitions. Framer Motion.

title: 5.4 Lookbook / editorial collection  Best for: fashion, lookbook, visual catalog.
prompt: Create a cinematic lookbook page, dark and editorial. Full-bleed alternating image blocks with parallax, oversized serif season title, thin captions, and subtle horizontal-scroll sequences between sections. Each look has a discreet "shop this" hover tag. Grain, slow ken-burns on images, magazine layout. Framer Motion.

title: 5.5 "Shop the look" / upsell  Best for: raising the ticket / cross-sell.
prompt: Design a cinematic "shop the look" / bundle section, near-black. One large lifestyle image with interactive hotspots; clicking a hotspot reveals the product in a glass card with price and add-to-cart. Below, a "complete the set" bundle with a combined price and savings badge, and a magnetic CTA. Film grain, smooth reveals. Framer Motion.

title: 6.1 App hero (floating mockup)  Best for: mobile app, fintech, product on the phone.
prompt: Create a cinematic mobile-app hero, near-black. A floating iPhone mockup center-right showing the app UI, tilted in 3D with a soft glow and floating glass notification cards around it. Oversized serif headline on the left, thin subheadline, and two CTAs (App Store / Google Play badges). Cursor-reactive parallax on the phone, film grain, slow ambient gradient. Premium, weightless.

title: 6.2 Full app landing  Best for: the app's entire page.
prompt: Build a full cinematic app landing (Next + Tailwind + Framer + Lenis), dark. Sections: (1) hero with floating phone + glow; (2) scroll-pinned feature section where the phone screen SWAPS as you scroll through features; (3) bento of benefits; (4) testimonials marquee; (5) download CTA with store badges + grain. Reduced-motion fallback, responsive, swappable screenshots.

title: 6.3 Download / store hero  Best for: focus on installing the app.
prompt: Design a cinematic download-focused app hero, near-black. Centered giant serif value prop, a phone mockup with a glowing screen, star-rating + "50k+ downloads" social proof, and large App Store / Google Play buttons with hover glow. A subtle QR code that pulses. Film grain, ambient motion. Conversion-focused, premium.

title: 6.4 Feature scroll (screens changing)  Best for: showing several app features.
prompt: Create a cinematic scroll-driven feature showcase for a mobile app. A sticky phone in the center; as the user scrolls, the phone screen transitions between feature screenshots with smooth crossfades, and the accompanying serif headline + description on the side change in sync. Neon accents, film grain, spring transitions. Framer Motion scroll-linked.

title: 6.5 Onboarding / how it works  Best for: explaining the app in steps.
prompt: Design a cinematic "how it works" section for an app, near-black. Three numbered steps in glass cards, each with a mini phone screenshot, a serif title, and a short line; a glowing connector line animates between them on scroll. Ambient gradient, film grain, staggered entrance. Framer Motion.

title: 7.1 Event hero  Best for: conference, workshop, show.
prompt: Create a cinematic event hero, near-black, high energy. Oversized serif event name filling the screen, date + location in thin uppercase below, an animated glow behind the title, and a bold "Get tickets" CTA. Optional looping background video of a crowd/venue with heavy vignette. Film grain, kinetic entrance. Awwwards event energy.

title: 7.2 Full event landing  Best for: the event's entire page.
prompt: Build a full cinematic event landing (Next + Tailwind + Framer + Lenis), dark. Sections: (1) hero with event name + countdown; (2) speakers grid with hover reveal; (3) schedule/agenda as a timeline; (4) ticket tiers in glass cards with a highlighted one; (5) venue + FAQ; (6) final "Secure your seat" CTA + grain. Responsive, smooth scroll.

title: 7.3 Speakers grid  Best for: highlighting speakers.
prompt: Design a cinematic speakers section, near-black. A grid of speaker cards with duotone portraits; on hover the portrait turns full-color, lifts, and reveals name + role + talk title. One "keynote" card larger with a glow. Film grain, staggered entrance. Framer Motion.

title: 7.4 Tickets / tiers  Best for: selling tickets.
prompt: Create a cinematic ticket-tiers section, near-black. Three glass ticket cards (Early / Standard / VIP), the VIP elevated with an amber glow halo and "Best value" ribbon; each with perks list and a magnetic "Buy ticket" button. A scarcity line ("Early bird ends soon"). Film grain, hover lift. Framer Motion.

title: 7.5 Countdown + registration  Best for: closing with urgency.
prompt: Design a cinematic countdown + register CTA band, near-black. A large glowing countdown to the event date, an oversized serif "Don't miss it", and a magnetic "Register now" button. Floating sponsor logos, ambient particles, film grain. Framer Motion timer.

title: 8.1 Fashion editorial hero  Best for: fashion, clothing brand, campaign.
prompt: Create a cinematic fashion editorial hero, dark and moody. A full-bleed campaign image (model/garment) bleeding to the edges with heavy grain, an oversized serif brand/campaign name overlapping it, thin uppercase season tag, and a discreet "Explore collection" CTA. Slow ken-burns on the image, cursor-follow light. Vogue-meets-Awwwards energy.

title: 8.2 Luxury brand landing  Best for: a full premium brand.
prompt: Build a full cinematic luxury brand landing (Next + Tailwind + Framer + Lenis), dark editorial. Sections: (1) campaign hero full-bleed; (2) collection grid with elegant hover zoom; (3) brand story with sticky imagery + serif pull-quotes; (4) craftsmanship detail block with macro shots; (5) boutique/CTA footer + grain. Generous whitespace, slow motion, responsive.

title: 8.3 Cinematic jewelry/watch product  Best for: jewelry, watchmaking, premium item.
prompt: Design a cinematic jewelry/watch product hero, near-black. The piece floating center under a single dramatic key light with sparkle highlights and soft reflection, macro-level detail, oversized serif name, poetic tagline, price, and a subtle "Acquire" button. Cursor-reactive light glint on the metal, film grain, slow rotation. Ultra-premium, weightless.

title: 8.4 Editorial collection / campaign  Best for: a collection launch.
prompt: Create a cinematic collection/campaign page, dark editorial. Alternating full-bleed campaign images with parallax, oversized serif collection name, thin poetic captions, and horizontal-scroll sequences between chapters. Discreet "shop the piece" hover tags. Grain, ken-burns, magazine pacing. Framer Motion.

title: 8.5 Brand story / boutique  Best for: about / brand heritage.
prompt: Design a cinematic brand-story section, dark and elegant. A sticky serif chapter title on the left while archival/craft imagery scrolls on the right, large pull-quotes about heritage, an animated "since 19XX" mark, and a boutique-locator CTA at the end. Film grain, slow reveals, generous whitespace. Framer Motion.

title: 1.1 Result headline  Best for: the hero of any product/service.
prompt: You are a premium direct-response copywriter. My product is [PRODUCT] and it helps [AUDIENCE] to [DESIRED RESULT]. Write 10 short headlines (max 8 words) for the hero of a cinematic site — confident, direct tone, no clichés, no "revolutionize". Each one focused on the result or the transformation. English.

title: 1.2 Provocative / tension headline  Best for: grabbing attention, breaking an objection.
prompt: Write 10 provocative headlines for my site's hero about [PRODUCT/AUDIENCE]. Each must create tension, contradict common sense, or point at the pain of [PROBLEM] — so the person stops to read. Short, sharp, without offending. English.

title: 1.3 "New category" headline  Best for: positioning yourself as unique.
prompt: My product is [PRODUCT]. I want to position myself as my own category, not "just another [COMPETITOR]". Write 8 headlines that name/hint at a new category or a new way of doing [ACTIVITY]. Confident, premium, English.

title: 2.1 Subheadline that explains in 1 line  Best for: below the headline in the hero.
prompt: My headline is "[HEADLINE]". Write 8 subheadlines of 1–2 lines that explain, in simple language, WHAT [PRODUCT] is, FOR WHOM, and the main benefit — without repeating the headline's words. Clear, premium tone. English.

title: 2.2 Subheadline with proof/number  Best for: giving credibility up top.
prompt: Write 6 subheadlines for the hero of [PRODUCT] that include a concrete proof: a number, a result, or a milestone (e.g. "used by X", "in Y days"). Use this real data: [YOUR DATA]. Short, confident, English.

title: 3.1 Main CTA  Best for: the hero and pricing button.
prompt: Write 12 button texts (CTAs) for [PRODUCT]. Short (2–4 words), in first person when it makes sense ("I want my X"), focused on action + benefit, avoiding "Submit" / "Learn more". English.

title: 3.2 Microcopy under the button  Best for: killing the last objection at the click.
prompt: Write 8 short microcopy lines (1 line) to place under the CTA button of [PRODUCT], reducing risk/friction (guarantee, "no card", "instant access"). Adapt to: [YOUR CONTEXT]. English.

title: 4.1 Features  benefit  Best for: the "what you get" section.
prompt: I have these features for [PRODUCT]: [LIST]. Rewrite each as a benefit block: a short title (result for the customer) + 1 supporting sentence. Translate function → transformation. Premium tone, English.

title: 4.2 "How it works" section (3 steps)  Best for: reducing the sense of complexity.
prompt: Explain how [PRODUCT] works in exactly 3 simple steps. Each step: an action verb in the title + 1 sentence. Make it feel easy and fast, without lying. English.

title: 4.3 "About / story" section  Best for: creating connection.
prompt: Write a short "about" section (100–140 words) for the site of [PRODUCT/BRAND]. Context: [YOUR STORY]. Human and confident tone, starting with a real tension or reason, ending on the mission. No corporate cliché. English.

title: 4.4 Social proof / testimonials  Best for: the credibility section.
prompt: Write 6 realistic testimonials for [PRODUCT], each focused on a different benefit and written the way a real person would speak (with a specific detail). Brand [NAME] and [ROLE]. English.

title: 5.1 Pricing copy  Best for: the plans/pricing section.
prompt: My price is [PRICE] for [PRODUCT]. Write: (1) a section title that anchors value, (2) 3 bullets of what's included (benefit), (3) a sentence that shrinks the price (e.g. "less than a coffee a day"). Confident, English.

title: 5.2 FAQ that breaks objections  Best for: frequently asked questions.
prompt: List the 8 main objections/doubts someone has before buying [PRODUCT] for [AUDIENCE]. For each, write the question the way the customer would ask it + a short, honest, reassuring answer. English.

title: 5.3 Final CTA block  Best for: the last section before the footer.
prompt: Write the closing block of the [PRODUCT] site: a strong title that restates the main promise, 1 reinforcing line, and a CTA. It should feel like "now is the moment". Short, premium, English.

title: 6.1 Honest urgency
prompt: Write 5 urgency/scarcity lines for [PRODUCT] that are TRUE in my case: [CONTEXT: spots, deadline, bonus, price going up]. Nothing fake. English.

title: 6.2 Meta title + description (SEO)
prompt: Write 3 options for a meta title (max 60 characters) and meta description (max 155) for the home of [PRODUCT], with the keyword [KEYWORD] and a CTA. English.

title: 6.3 Delivery/welcome email
prompt: Write a short welcome/delivery email for whoever bought [PRODUCT]: thank them, deliver the access [LINK], give the first step to use it, and leave a contact channel. Human and upbeat, no filler. English.

part: The Formula  create your own prompts

prompt: Create a full-viewport cinematic hero for a premium specialty coffee brand. Oversized serif brand name centered, a macro photo of coffee beans as a dark background, single CTA below. Near-black palette, warm raking light grazing the beans, film grain, vignette. Slow fade-in on load and a subtle ken-burns zoom on the photo. Next.js + Tailwind + Framer Motion. Awwwards-grade, editorial coffee-magazine energy.
